## 中文

山川异域，风月同天。

海内存知己，天涯若比邻。

明月松间照，清泉石上流。

## 日本語

春はあけぼの。やうやう白くなりゆく山ぎは。

夏は夜。月のころはさらなり。

秋は夕暮れ。冬はつとめて。

## 한국어

봄은 새벽이다. 하늘이 조금씩 밝아진다.

여름은 밤이다. 달빛이 조용히 비친다.

가을은 저녁이다. 겨울은 이른 아침이다.

## 混合表格

A table is the one construct vertical text renders better than horizontal:
each row becomes a column, so an entry reads top to bottom.

| 蒙古文 | 转写 | 音标 | English |
|---|---|---|---|
| ᠰᠠᠶᠢᠨ | sayin | sain | good |
| ᠪᠢ | bi | bi | I |
| ᠨᠡᠷ᠎ᠡ | ner_e | ner | name |
| ᠪᠠᠶᠠᠷᠯᠠᠯ᠎ᠠ | bayarlal_a | bayarlalaa | thank you |
| 山 | aGula | uul | mountain |

## English

It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.

However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighbourhood, this truth is so well fixed in the minds of the surrounding families, that he is considered the rightful property of some one or other of their daughters.

## Rust

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct LayoutConfig {
    max_word_width: 24,
    column_advance_left: true,
}

fn split_identifier(hi_nancy: &str, max_width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
    hi_nancy
        .chars()
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .chunks(max_width)
        .map(|part| part.iter().collect())
        .collect()
}

fn main() {
    let config = LayoutConfig {
        max_word_width: 24,
        column_advance_left: true,
    };
    let greeting = "vertical code";
    let marker: &'static str = "hi_nancy";
    let parts = split_identifier("hi_nancy", config.max_word_width);

    for part in parts {
        println!("{greeting} {marker}: {part}");
    }
}
```
:::
